title: Catalog
subtitle: Products with standard shelf life and dishes with per-portion recipes. Expiry, stock and the stop list are calculated from them.

products.formHint: Standard shelf life is used when the supplier gives no date; the minimum stock drives “What to order”.
products.name: Name
products.shelfLifeHint: Empty — the expiry is given in every delivery.
products.minStockHint: Below it the product appears in “What to order”.
products.packSizeHint: Orders are rounded up to whole packs.
products.unitLocked: The unit of an existing product isn't changed — it already has stock and movements.

dishes.formHint: The recipe is per portion — products are taken from stock by it when an order is placed.
dishes.name: Name
dishes.activeHint: Untick to take the dish off the menu by hand — it goes into the stop list.
dishes.compositionHint: Weight and volume in grams and millilitres, everything else in pieces.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.price: Price — a number with at most two decimals.
errors.emptyComposition: Add at least one product to the recipe.
errors.duplicate: This product is already in the recipe.
